name: Alto DUSD
oneLiner: DUSD is Alto's overcollateralized USD stablecoin minted from isolated on-chain markets backed by ETH, BTC, and yield-bearing variants, with a 5M USDC PSM.
collateral: Over-collateralized on-chain assets in isolated lending markets on Ethereum: mint markets accept WETH, wstETH (Lido), rETH (Rocket Pool), mETH (Mantle LST), sUSDe (Ethena), and Syrup USDC; borrow markets accept cbBTC, WBTC, tBTC, sUSDe, Syrup USDC, and PAXG; each market is independently isolated with per-asset risk parameters; a Peg Stability Module enables 1:1 USDC↔DUSD swaps capped at 5M USDC
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized minting via isolated lending markets (mint and borrow); peg backstopped by a PSM enabling 1:1 USDC↔DUSD swaps at 0.20% fee (5M USDC cap); arbitrageurs exploit the PSM rate vs. market price to restore peg; all markets governed by ALTO token holder votes

oracleRisk.summary: Public docs reviewed for Alto DUSD do not identify the collateral oracle setup or failure handling.

mintAuthority.summary: DUSD token (0x63d74d22e689c715a04f2c13962b1f77f443d35b) is owned by AltoTimelockController (0xfae841679dc1a93d225ecc827e4bbf3e8d703f86, 1-hour min delay, self-administered). The timelock's proposer/executor is a 3-of-5 Alto Safe (0xc49bf619cc9a68f84a6c9ab88506f2627565a4d0). All deployer roles were revoked on-chain. Token minting requires onlyOwner (= timelock). Mint markets and PSM are contract-gated with per-market ceilings.

controls.label: Alto isolated mint markets (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by per-market debt ceilings and collateral risk parameters; markets must be in allowedMinter mapping.
controls.evidence: DUSD contract source (AltoOwnable2Step + Pausable + OFT) confirms mint() is gated by allowedMinter[msg.sender] and per-minter ceiling; setMinterStatus/setMinterCeiling require onlyOwner (= timelock). Market-level mint caps enforced on-chain.

controls.label: Alto DUSD/USDC PSM
controls.capDescription: The public PSM can mint DUSD against USDC and burn DUSD for USDC, bounded by a 5,000,000 USDC capacity and 0.20% fee.
controls.evidence: PSM must be in allowedMinter mapping; subject to same ceiling enforcement as other minters.

controls.label: AltoTimelockController (DUSD owner)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203: DUSD.owner() = 0xfae841679dc1a93d225ecc827e4bbf3e8d703f86 (AltoTimelockController, confirmed via Blockscout source). Timelock getMinDelay() = 3600s (1 hour). Timelock has DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for itself. Deployer (0xba5ed2b...) had all roles revoked (RoleRevoked events confirmed on-chain). Current proposer/executor: Alto Safe (0xc49bf619cc9a68f84a6c9ab88506f2627565a4d0).

controls.label: Alto governance Safe (proposer/executor on timelock)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203: 0xc49bf619cc9a68f84a6c9ab88506f2627565a4d0 confirmed as GnosisSafe via Blockscout; getOwners() = 5 addresses; getThreshold() = 3; no modules detected. RoleGranted logs confirm this Safe holds PROPOSER_ROLE and EXECUTOR_ROLE on the timelock (granted by timelock itself, not deployer).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203: DUSD token owner() = AltoTimelockController (0xfae841679dc1a93d225ecc827e4bbf3e8d703f86, 1hr min delay, self-admin). DUSD source confirms mint() gated by allowedMinter mapping; setMinterStatus onlyOwner. Timelock proposer/executor = Alto Safe (0xc49bf619..., 5 owners, threshold 3, no modules); RoleGranted/RoleRevoked logs confirm deployer roles fully revoked, Safe granted roles by timelock.

reserves.name: frxUSD held by the DUSD USM

sources.label: Alto DUSD mint and borrow documentation

reserveReview.rationale: Alto documents that only mint markets create DUSD; borrow markets redistribute lender-supplied DUSD and therefore are not backing sources. The July 14 issuer API reports current DUSD debt for each active mint market and identifies frxUSD as the USM backing token. Normalizing those mint debts with the USM's 822,997.840132 frxUSD balance read at Ethereum block 25530496 yields 90.4% frxUSD, 5.9% ETH/LST collateral, 3.6% sUSDe, and 0.1% syrupUSDC after one-decimal rounding.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current issuer API mint-market DUSD debt combined with the on-chain USM underlying balance
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All active DUSD issuance paths and their direct backing assets are identified.
